old_problem: The historical review treated the read command and core field semantics as unknown. IPMI 2.0 section 31.11a and Appendix G explicitly define Get SEL Time UTC Offset as Storage NetFn 0Ah/Cmd 5Ch with no request data and a two-byte little-endian signed-minute response. Section 31.11b defines the UTC-to-SEL sign, range, unspecified sentinel and DST responsibility. Only target support and the Project's expected timezone/sentinel policy remain runtime inputs, so neither Pending nor BLOCKED is justified.
disposition_reason: Issue one local-interface Storage 0Ah/5Ch read with no request bytes, require successful completion and exactly two response-data bytes, combine them least-significant byte first, recognize 07FFh before signed conversion, otherwise decode a 16-bit two's-complement value and require -1440 through +1440 minutes. Compare the result to the approved Project timezone policy at the captured instant, including the applicable DST offset, and optionally cross-check the SEL local-time relationship against a trusted UTC source using a Project-approved skew. The command is optional unless Set 5Dh is implemented; unsupported is N/A only with authoritative platform evidence. Never infer the stored value from host timezone, clear SEL, call a setter, repair the clock or retry automatically.
decision_basis: Master XLSX rows 1076-1080, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT second review, tests_gpt_merged, selection manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. tests.json contains one occurrence of this code. The related OOB getter is row 1205 / variant 0b80bfd6fd426cca and remains separate. Formal queue sequence 73 was independently verified as row 1079 / variant 2f9b3065b6642849.

IPMI v2.0 Appendix G assigns Get SEL Time UTC Offset to Storage NetFn 0Ah/Cmd 5Ch. Section 31.11a specifies no request data and a response consisting of the completion code plus exactly two offset bytes.

The two offset bytes are a 16-bit two's-complement signed integer, least-significant byte first, measured in minutes from UTC to SEL Time. Normal values range from -1440 to +1440 minutes; 07FFh is the distinct unspecified sentinel and means to interpret SEL time as local time.

Section 31.11b fixes the sign convention: local SEL time equals UTC plus the offset, and UTC equals SEL time minus the offset. It also states that daylight-saving changes may require software to update the stored offset.

Get 5Ch is optional in general but mandatory when Set 5Dh is implemented. A nonzero unsupported-command completion can therefore support N/A only when the exact platform/firmware specification confirms the feature is not applicable; it is FAIL when Project requirements or observed Set support require Get.

An expected value is not universal. The Project timezone policy must provide either an expected signed-minute value for the captured instant, including DST, or an explicit expectation that 07FFh is allowed. That parameter is execution readiness under ED-34, not unresolved command semantics.

The later command-specific sections and Appendix G expressly define the SEL UTC-offset field. The general timestamp discussion's older statement about no system GMT-offset command does not override these explicit normative command tables; this test validates the SEL field, not an OS-wide timezone service.

The operation is read-only, but a plausible two-byte result is not sufficient: response length, endian order, sentinel-first decoding, range, target identity, Project policy and time-basis relationship all need evidence. Host timezone alone is not an oracle.

ED-03 permits standard BMC commands while forbidding guessed OEM behavior; ED-13 and ED-15 govern N/A and exact acceptance; ED-17 preserves SEL evidence; ED-19 keeps IB and OOB separate; ED-34 parameterizes Project values; ED-38 prohibits automatic retry.

test_case.test_name: IPMI Get SEL Time UTC Offset (IB Storage 0Ah/5Ch) signed-minute decode and time-policy validation
test_case.purpose: Read the standard SEL UTC-offset field once through the local IPMI interface, prove its exact wire shape and signed-minute interpretation, and compare it with the approved current Project timezone policy without changing clocks, offset, SEL contents or the distinct OOB coverage.
required_package: Approved target BMC/firmware identity, working local IPMI system interface and a version-pinned ipmitool or equivalent raw runner that preserves exit status, completion code, stderr and exact response bytes
Project configuration selecting EXPECTED_SEL_UTC_OFFSET_MINUTES in [-1440,1440] or EXPECT_UNSPECIFIED_07FFH, with named timezone, captured effective date/time and DST policy

When chronology accuracy is in scope: a trusted UTC reference, paired Get SEL Time 0Ah/48h reader and an approved ALLOWED_CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS threshold; absence of that threshold is NOT READY, never an invented PASS margin
Parser unit evidence for little-endian/signed/sentinel cases such as 00 00=0, E0 01=+480, 20 FE=-480 and FF 07=unspecified
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PROCEDURE; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Record Source Key/variant, target BMC/firmware and local-interface identity; preserve existing SEL evidence and do not run the source boilerplate's log clear. Resolve the approved expected policy for the exact test instant, including DST. Using the versioned runner, issue exactly `ipmitool -I open raw 0x0a 0x5c` with no request-data bytes and no retry. Capture exit status, stderr and the two response-data bytes (or the transport's explicit completion code plus those bytes). Require completion 00h and exactly two data bytes B0 B1. Compute U=B0|(B1<<8); if U==0x07FF classify UNSPECIFIED, otherwise compute OFFSET_MIN=U when U<0x8000 else U-0x10000 and require -1440<=OFFSET_MIN<=1440. Compare the decoded state exactly with EXPECTED_SEL_UTC_OFFSET_MINUTES or EXPECT_UNSPECIFIED_07FFH. If chronology validation is required, bracket a 0Ah/48h Get SEL Time read with trusted UTC timestamps and verify SEL local time = UTC + OFFSET_MIN within the approved skew; no such conversion is claimed for 07FFh. Capture post-read SEL metadata/audit evidence showing the procedure issued no setter or clear. Keep row 1205 OOB evidence separate.
test_case.expected_result: The local read completes successfully and returns exactly two offset bytes. FF 07 is reported only as the 07FFh unspecified sentinel; every other response decodes little-endian as a signed value from -1440 through +1440 minutes. The state equals the Project's approved expectation for that instant and DST condition. When required and when the value is specified, the independently sampled SEL-time relationship meets the approved skew. A required implementation cannot return unsupported. An optional unsupported implementation is N/A only with authoritative target evidence. No clock, UTC offset, SEL entry or log state is changed.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the exact IB Source Key/variant, verified target identity, 0Ah/5Ch with zero request bytes, completion 00h, exactly two response bytes, correct sentinel-before-signed decoding, valid range, an approved timestamped Project expected state and exact match; chronology scope additionally requires the approved UTC/skew comparison. FAIL covers malformed length, endian/sign error, non-sentinel out-of-range value, expected-value mismatch, DST-policy mismatch, required-but-unsupported command, unauthorized mutation, log clearing or evidence borrowed from OOB. NOT READY covers a missing target, runner, expected policy or required skew. N/A requires authoritative proof that this optional command is unsupported and Set 5Dh is not implemented; command error alone is insufficient.
safety_gate: This identity is local/in-band only. Do not substitute row 1205 OOB results or silently change transport/options.

Send only Storage 0Ah/Cmd5Ch with an empty request body. Any proposed data byte, Set 5Dh, Set SEL Time 49h, host clock change or repair action is outside this test and requires a separate reviewed identity.
Do not clear SEL, dmesg or syslog. Preserve chronology evidence; natural concurrent SEL additions must be timestamped and distinguished from test-induced mutation rather than erased.
Bind the expectation to an approved timezone and exact instant. Do not infer the BMC field from `/etc/localtime`, a browser display or the operator workstation without Project authority.
Recognize 07FFh before two's-complement conversion; do not accept it as +2047 or as an ordinary out-of-range value. Reject all other decoded values outside -1440..+1440.
Issue once and do not automatically retry. On transport, completion, length or policy mismatch, preserve raw evidence and stop; do not invoke setters to make the read pass.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant, BMC/firmware/local-interface identity, official sections 31.11a/31.11b and Appendix G authority, plus the distinct row-1205 OOB identity
Versioned raw runner/package hash, exact no-data request, timestamp, exit status/completion code, stderr and unmodified two response bytes
Sentinel-first decode trace showing U and either UNSPECIFIED or signed OFFSET_MIN with range result
Approved Project timezone/sentinel policy, effective instant and DST state, with exact comparison result
If required, trusted UTC and paired SEL-time samples, approved skew and computed `SEL=UTC+offset` comparison
Read-only command audit, preserved SEL context and final PASS/FAIL/NOT READY/N/A plus engineer verdict; explicitly record that the review agent executed no DUT action
test_case.recovery: No state recovery is normally required because 5Ch is read-only. On failure, preserve the raw response, target identity, timestamps and SEL context, mark FAIL/NOT READY/N/A as applicable, and stop without retry, clock correction, offset write or log clearing. If the audit shows an unintended setter or clock mutation occurred outside this defined procedure, quarantine subsequent chronology evidence and hand restoration to the time/BMC owner under the separately reviewed Set identity; this getter must not attempt repair.

source_conflict.reason: The official IPMI command tables resolve the TBD command, response size, endian/sign, unit, range and sentinel. The review layer removes the contradictory generic log-clear step and parameterizes only the Project's expected timezone state.

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1 E7
external_authorities.application: Sections 31.11a and 31.11b plus Table 31-1 and Appendix G define optional Storage 0Ah/Cmd5Ch, the mandatory relationship to Set 5Dh, the two-byte little-endian signed-minute response, -1440..+1440 range, 07FFh unspecified sentinel, UTC-to-SEL sign and DST update semantics.

project_authority: The BMC/time owner supplies target support evidence and the timestamped expected timezone or sentinel policy, including DST and any required UTC/skew oracle, and owns the DUT verdict. The Project cannot redefine the wire encoding, accept an unapproved threshold, infer the field from host time, treat command error alone as N/A, merge IB/OOB evidence or authorize this getter to change clocks/logs.
